notes_zh: 2711 编辑器统一视觉规范 — Makoto Shinkai 2D 水彩动漫背景 + 中国场景语境（校园食堂/菜市场/庙会/地铁高铁/灯笼节等），严禁摄影/写实/3D。人群密度按场景类型：社交/公共=多人，自然/静谧=可空。
locale_note: Prompts default to Chinese everyday settings (school cafeteria, wet market, temple fair, HSR platform, campus corridor) — NOT Western stock-photo or live-action references.
crowd_policy: Match crowd density to scene type. Social/public locations (cafeteria, classroom, market, train platform, festival, corridor, cafe, street) MUST include many people or a bustling crowd — NOT empty or a single lonely figure. Quiet nature scenes (meadow, peaks, night stars, shrine at dawn, fog forest, beach cliff) may stay empty or sparse.
